wand-specialization.name: Wand Specialization
wand-specialization.r1: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.
wand-specialization.rmax: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

improved-channeling.name: Improved Channeling
improved-channeling.r1: Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 20% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 14% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
improved-channeling.rmax: Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 100% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

arcane-resilience.name: Arcane Resilience
arcane-resilience.r1: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 25% of your Intellect.
arcane-resilience.rmax: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 75% of your Intellect.

arcane-subtlety.name: Arcane Subtlety
arcane-subtlety.r1: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 8 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 15%.
arcane-subtlety.rmax: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

magic-absorption.name: Magic Absorption
magic-absorption.r1: Increases all your resistances by 5 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.
magic-absorption.rmax: Increases all your resistances by 10 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 2% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

arcane-concentration.name: Arcane Concentration
arcane-concentration.r1: Gives you a 2% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.
arcane-concentration.rmax: Gives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

missile-barrage.name: Missile Barrage
missile-barrage.r1: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 20% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 10% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.
missile-barrage.rmax: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

arcane-geometry.name: Arcane Geometry
arcane-geometry.r1: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 3 yards.
arcane-geometry.rmax: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards.

arcane-impact.name: Arcane Impact
arcane-impact.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 2%.
arcane-impact.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%.

arcane-blast.name: Arcane Blast
arcane-blast.cost: 15% of base mana · 30 yd range · 1.5 sec cast
arcane-blast.r1: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 34 to 38 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 12% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 100%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 18 sec from time of initial application.
arcane-blast.rmax: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 34 to 38 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 12% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 100%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 18 sec from time of initial application.

arcane-shielding.name: Arcane Shielding
arcane-shielding.r1: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 17% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 25%.
arcane-shielding.rmax: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 50%.

improved-counterspell.name: Improved Counterspell
improved-counterspell.r1: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 2 sec.
improved-counterspell.rmax: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

arcane-meditation.name: Arcane Meditation
arcane-meditation.r1: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
arcane-meditation.rmax: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

arcane-wrath.name: Arcane Wrath
arcane-wrath.cost: 140 Mana · 30 yd range · 3.5 sec cast · 6 sec cooldown
arcane-wrath.r1: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 122 to 146 Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to 5% of your maximum Mana.
arcane-wrath.rmax: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 122 to 146 Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to 5% of your maximum Mana.

presence-of-mind.name: Presence of Mind
presence-of-mind.r1: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.
presence-of-mind.rmax: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

arcane-mind.name: Arcane Mind
arcane-mind.r1: Increases your Intellect by 2% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 20%.
arcane-mind.rmax: Increases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%.

arcane-instability.name: Arcane Instability
arcane-instability.r1: Increases the damage done by your spells by 1% and your critical strike chance by 1%.
arcane-instability.rmax: Increases the damage done by your spells by 3% and your critical strike chance by 3%.

arcane-power.name: Arcane Power
arcane-power.r1: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.
arcane-power.rmax: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

incineration.name: Incineration
incineration.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 2%.
incineration.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 10%.

accelerant.name: Accelerant
accelerant.r1: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.1 sec.
accelerant.rmax: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.5 sec.

ignite.name: Ignite
ignite.r1: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 8% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.
ignite.rmax: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

flame-throwing.name: Flame Throwing
flame-throwing.r1: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 3 yards.
flame-throwing.rmax: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 6 yards.

impact.name: Impact
impact.r1: Gives your Fire spells a 3% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.
impact.rmax: Gives your Fire spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

burning-soul.name: Burning Soul
burning-soul.r1: Gives your Fire spells a 23% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 10%.
burning-soul.rmax: Gives your Fire spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 30%.

improved-flamestrike.name: Improved Flamestrike
improved-flamestrike.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 5%.
improved-flamestrike.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 15%.

pyroblast.name: Pyroblast
pyroblast.r1: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.
pyroblast.rmax: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.

improved-fire-blast.name: Improved Fire Blast
improved-fire-blast.r1: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 1 sec and increases its range by 8 yards.
improved-fire-blast.rmax: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec and increases its range by 15 yards.

improved-scorch.name: Improved Scorch
improved-scorch.r1: Your Scorch spell has a 33% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.
improved-scorch.rmax: Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

improved-fire-ward.name: Improved Fire Ward
improved-fire-ward.r1: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 10% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.
improved-fire-ward.rmax: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 20% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

heating-up.name: Heating Up
heating-up.r1: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage.
heating-up.rmax: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage.

master-of-elements.name: Master of Elements
master-of-elements.r1: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 10% of their base mana cost.
master-of-elements.rmax: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 30% of their base mana cost.

critical-mass.name: Critical Mass
critical-mass.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 2%.
critical-mass.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 6%.

blast-wave.name: Blast Wave
blast-wave.r1: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 154 to 184 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.
blast-wave.rmax: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 154 to 184 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

fire-power.name: Fire Power
fire-power.r1: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 1% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of 4%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.
fire-power.rmax: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 3% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.

combustion.name: Combustion
combustion.r1: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.
combustion.rmax: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

frost-warding.name: Frost Warding
frost-warding.r1: Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 15%, gives your Frost Ward a 10% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by 10%.
frost-warding.rmax: Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 30%, gives your Frost Ward a 20% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by 20%.

improved-frostbolt.name: Improved Frostbolt
improved-frostbolt.r1: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.1 sec.
improved-frostbolt.rmax: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.5 sec.

precision.name: Precision
precision.r1: Improves your chance to hit with all spells by 2%.
precision.rmax: Improves your chance to hit with all spells by 6%.

ice-shards.name: Ice Shards
ice-shards.r1: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 20%.
ice-shards.rmax: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.r1: Gives your Chill effects a 5% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.
frostbite.rmax: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

improved-frost-nova.name: Improved Frost Nova
improved-frost-nova.r1: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 2 sec.
improved-frost-nova.rmax: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 4 sec.

permafrost.name: Permafrost
permafrost.r1: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 11% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 3%.
permafrost.rmax: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%.

frost-channeling.name: Frost Channeling
frost-channeling.r1: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 5% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 10%.
frost-channeling.rmax: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%.

improved-blizzard.name: Improved Blizzard
improved-blizzard.r1: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 15% for 1.5 sec.
improved-blizzard.rmax: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec.

ice-lance.name: Ice Lance
ice-lance.cost: 45 Mana · 30 yd range · Instant · 8 sec cooldown
ice-lance.r1: Deals 28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.
ice-lance.rmax: Deals 28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

arctic-reach.name: Arctic Reach
arctic-reach.r1: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 10%.
arctic-reach.rmax: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 20%.

ice-block.name: Ice Block
ice-block.r1: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.
ice-block.rmax: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 17%.
shatter.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 50%.

improved-cone-of-cold.name: Improved Cone of Cold
improved-cone-of-cold.r1: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 12%.
improved-cone-of-cold.rmax: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 35%.

cold-snap.name: Cold Snap
cold-snap.r1: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.
cold-snap.rmax: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

fingers-of-frost.name: Fingers of Frost
fingers-of-frost.r1: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 1 spell cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.
fingers-of-frost.rmax: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

winter-s-chill.name: Winter's Chill
winter-s-chill.r1: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 20% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.
winter-s-chill.rmax: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 100% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

ice-barrier.name: Ice Barrier
ice-barrier.r1: Shield yourself, absorbing 493 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.
ice-barrier.rmax: Shield yourself, absorbing 493 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.
